identity_marker: dark gray ResMed AirSense 10 CPAP machine with an angled LCD screen

video_goal: A step-by-step visual guide on assembling and powering on a ResMed AirSense 10 CPAP machine with a heated humidifier.
single_prompt: A medium shot captures two hands placing the dark gray ResMed AirSense 10 CPAP machine with an angled LCD screen onto a wooden nightstand under warm, soft bedroom lighting. The camera moves to a close-up as a hand inserts the circular power plug into the rear port, illuminating a green LED on the power brick. From an over-the-shoulder view, a thumb presses the side release latch and pulls the clear plastic HumidAir water chamber out. In a close-up, a hand flips open the chamber lid and pours distilled water exactly up to the 'Max' fill line. Two thumbs press down on the clear plastic lid until a visible snap occurs. A medium close-up shows a hand sliding the filled water chamber back into the side slot until it sits flush. From a first-person view, fingers pinch the orange connector end of the gray ClimateLineAir heated tubing. A close-up reveals a hand aligning the orange connector with the circular air port on the back of the machine and pushing it inward, then twisting it clockwise until it locks. In a first-person view, the opposite end of the gray tubing is pushed firmly onto the hard plastic swivel connector of a CPAP mask. A close-up shows an index finger pressing the large 'Start/Stop' button on the top right. Finally, an extreme close-up captures the angled LCD screen illuminating brightly, displaying a green 'SmartStart' icon and a numerical pressure dial.
